title: Edelweiss at Soho Playhouse #edelweiss #ontherockstheatrecompany #soh...
transcript: Sometimes a show really has you thinking “WTF is this? (complimentary)” and that was Edelweiss for me. This is a zippy, roughly 45-minute holiday pageant featuring four musical elves and a dancing reindeer. Santa has unexpectedly died, so this pageant-turned-memorial is somewhat of a last-ditch effort to save Christmas. It's very off-beat but touts a well-sharpened sense of humor and some surprisingly poignant moments. Every character is strange and specific but unequivocally in the same world as one another. If your experience of this show is anything like mine, you'll leave somewhat confused, but definitely charmed. On The Rocks Theatre Company is presenting Edelweiss at a ridiculously decked out Soho Playhouse through this weekend. With that, another program for my collection.
